name: Sergo Vares
biography: Sergo Vares (born on September 14, 1982 in Rakvere) is an Estonian actor. Vares graduated from Rakvere Gymnasium in 2001. In 2002, he enrolled at the University of Tartu to study journalism, but left to study acting at the Estonian Academy of Music and Theatre under course instructor Priit Pedajas, graduating in 2006.
birthplace: Rakvere, Rakvere District, Estonian SSR, USSR [now Lääne-Viru County, Estonia]
